title: Claude tests your site in a real browser
blurb: Lets Claude open your site, click through it, fill in forms, and tell you what's broken — the same way a person would check it.
newcomerProblem: You changed something and don't know if the page still works.
tryThis: Open localhost:3000 and tell me if the login form works
tryThisExplain: Start your site first, then ask Claude this in your own words.
explain: A tool is something extra you plug into Claude so it can reach outside your files. This one gives Claude a real browser it can drive: it opens pages, clicks buttons, types into forms, and reads what came back. You describe what to check in plain English, and it goes and looks.
honestLimit: The first run downloads the browser, which takes a minute and needs an internet connection.
uninstallNote: This removes it from this project. The downloaded browser stays on your computer; nothing else is changed.
